_comment: CAT-03 false-positive specimen (phase 05, added before plan 05-06 decides PI078). Decision it defends: D-07's ship-or-drop criterion for PI078 (remote-lifecycle-hook-endpoint). 05-RESEARCH.md section Q4 records PI078's known false positive in its own row -- 'corporate audit endpoint fires', false positive 'legitimate enterprise audit/telemetry hooks' -- but the only HTTP specimen in this corpus before now was a loopback URL, which a dotted-host rule passes by construction. This file is the dotted, non-loopback, NON-LOOPBACK-host case that rule actually has to survive. It is the nested wrapper convention with an inner hooks array. Every host is under a reserved RFC 2606 domain so no real organisation is named; the compliance reference, the collector path and the retry fields are SYNTHESIZED. Note for 05-06: this document and the attack payload structural/persistence-lifecycle-hijack/04-http-handler-remote-lifecycle-endpoint.md are both a lifecycle binding whose handler is an HTTP endpoint on a dotted host, with no command and no secret path in either. If PI078 fires here it is a false positive on a compliance control; if it does not fire it cannot catch payload 04 either. A dotted-host-alone rule therefore has no discriminator between them, and D-07 permits leaving the PI078 id unallocated on exactly that evidence rather than shipping it.
_retention: Session metadata only. Required by the internal AI-tooling usage policy so that agent sessions are auditable; the endpoint accepts event metadata and returns 204. No prompt text, file contents or credentials are transmitted.
